Task instructions:
Task: Compositional policy 006

Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action delete in context sandbox; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role admin or guest, except for action delete; a trusted change prefers allow at priority 80. Action approve in context sandbox prefers deny at priority 70. Role guest or context internal prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Declared labels: allow, deny, review
